fullPassage: In a study, Guy Mayraz, a behavioral economist, showed his experimental subjects graphs of a price rising and falling over time. The graphs were actually of past changes in the stock market, but Mayraz told people that the graphs showed recent changes in the price of wheat. He asked each person to predict where the price would move next — and offered them a reward if their forecasts came true. But Mayraz had also divided his participants into two categories, "farmers" and "bakers". Farmers would be paid extra if wheat prices were high. Bakers would earn a bonus if wheat was cheap. So the subjects might earn two separate payments: one for an accurate forecast, and a bonus if the price of wheat moved in their direction. Mayraz found that the prospect of the bonus influenced the forecast itself. The farmers hoped and predicted that the price of wheat would rise. The bakers hoped for — and predicted — the opposite. They let their hopes influence their reasoning.

questions.passage: In a study, Guy Mayraz, a __________ (behave) economist, showed his experimental subjects graphs of a price rising and falling over time.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (영어로) 쓰시오. (1단어)

det.korean: behavioral(행동의, 행동과학의)
det.analysis: behave(동사, 행동하다) → behavioral(형용사, 행동의): economist(경제학자)를 수식하는 형용사가 필요

questions.passage: So the subjects might earn two separate __________ (pay): one for an accurate forecast, and a bonus if the price of wheat moved in their direction.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (영어로) 쓰시오. (1단어)

det.korean: payments(지급금, 지불금)
det.analysis: pay(동사, 지불하다) → payments(명사, 복수형): two 뒤에 복수 명사 필요. separate가 형용사로 수식

questions.passage: In a study, Guy Mayraz, a behavioral economist, showed his experimental subjects graphs of a price rising and falling over time. The graphs were actually of past changes in the stock market, but Mayraz told people that the graphs showed recent changes in the price of wheat. He asked each person to predict where the price would move next — and offered them a reward if their forecasts __________. But Mayraz had also divided his participants into two categories, "farmers" and "bakers". Farmers would be paid extra if wheat prices were high. Bakers would earn a bonus if wheat was cheap. So the subjects might earn two separate payments: one for an accurate forecast, and a bonus if the price of wheat moved in their direction. Mayraz found that the prospect of the bonus influenced the forecast itself. The farmers hoped and predicted that the price of wheat would rise. The bakers hoped for — and predicted — the opposite. They let their hopes influence their reasoning.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 빈칸에 came true(실현되다)가 적절: 예측이 실현되면 보상을 제공하겠다는 문맥
det.analysis:
✅ ① came true(실현되다): 예측이 맞으면 보상을 준다는 문맥 ← 정답
❌ ② were divided(나뉘었다): 예측의 실현과 무관
❌ ③ moved next(다음으로 이동하다): 문맥상 부적합
❌ ④ earned a bonus(보너스를 받다): 조건이 아닌 결과를 서술

questions.passage: In a study, Guy Mayraz, a behavioral economist, showed his experimental subjects graphs of a price rising and falling over time. The graphs were actually of past changes in the stock market, but Mayraz told people that the graphs showed recent changes in the price of wheat. He asked each person to predict where the price would move next — and offered them a reward if their forecasts came true. But Mayraz had also divided his participants into two categories, "farmers" and "bakers". Farmers would be paid extra if wheat prices were high. Bakers would earn a bonus if wheat was cheap. So the subjects might earn two separate payments: one for an accurate forecast, and a bonus if the price of wheat moved __________. Mayraz found that the prospect of the bonus influenced the forecast itself. The farmers hoped and predicted that the price of wheat would rise. The bakers hoped for — and predicted — the opposite. They let their hopes influence their reasoning.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 빈칸에 in their direction(그들이 원하는 방향으로)이 적절: 밀가루 가격이 자신에게 유리한 방향으로 움직이면 보너스를 받는다는 문맥
det.analysis:
❌ ① over time(시간이 지남에 따라): 가격 이동 방향이 아닌 시간 표현
❌ ② into two categories(두 범주로): 참가자 분류 맥락이지 가격 이동이 아님
✅ ③ in their direction(그들의 방향으로): 가격이 유리하게 움직이면 보너스 ← 정답
❌ ④ for an accurate forecast(정확한 예측을 위해): 앞 문장에서 이미 언급된 조건
det.tip: in their direction = 그들에게 유리한 방향으로
